title: DECSET 1003 — Any-event mouse tracking
summary: CSI ? 1003 h enables any-event mouse tracking: the terminal reports all motion, even with no button held. CSI ? 1003 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1003 h Mouse tracking; all motion events.

gotchas: Any-event mode is very noisy (reports every cell the pointer crosses); use sparingly.
Combine with 1006 (SGR encoding) for coordinates beyond 223 columns/rows.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1003 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1003 h/l sequences.
